# Harnessing Claude Code

> From zero to graph engineering on AI agents — for people who use them.
> 119 lessons across 20 phases. The path is the URL.

## API and MCP

- [Developer documentation](developer.html): public read-only API, MCP server, errors, quotas, versioning.
- [OpenAPI 3.1](openapi.json): typed REST operations.
- [MCP manifest](server.json): connect using Streamable HTTP at https://harnessing.example/mcp.

> A free, open-source course on using AI agents well. Not an ML course — it assumes
> you're using models, not training them. Lessons are markdown at
> `phases/NN-phase/NN-slug/docs/en.md`. Read them via the API or directly.

Canonical site: https://harnessing.example
Source: https://github.com/your-org/harnessing-claude-code
Lesson words: ~119 · Phases: 20 · Practice modules: 16

## Developer resources

- [Developer documentation](developer.html) — machine-readable site contracts
- [OpenAPI description](openapi.json) — typed REST API
- [Sitemap](sitemap.xml) — canonical URL inventory

- [Catalog](catalog.html) — all 119 lessons

## Lesson URL scheme

`/phases/NN-phase-slug/NN-lesson-slug.html` — every lesson is one directory at this path. The path is the URL.

Example: `/phases/00-setup-and-tooling/01-dev-environment.html` is Lesson 1 of Phase 0.

## Phase 0: Setup & Tooling
Your tools shape your thinking.

- [Dev Environment](phases/00-setup-and-tooling/01-dev-environment.html) — Verify your tools are real, write CLAUDE.md, get your bearings.
- [Git as Your Safety Net](phases/00-setup-and-tooling/02-git-and-collaboration.html) — Four states, the safety net, recovery.
- [Terminal and Shell](phases/00-setup-and-tooling/03-terminal-and-shell.html) — Read what the agent is about to run.
- [Editor Setup](phases/00-setup-and-tooling/04-editor-setup.html) — Format-on-save, integrated terminal, project-wide search, bound test runner.
- [Debugging and Profiling](phases/00-setup-and-tooling/05-debugging-and-profiling.html) — Most agent problems are environment problems.

## Phase 3: Models & Families
When small wins. Open-weight vs frontier. Decision models beat generation on cost.

- [Open-Weight vs Frontier](phases/03-models-and-families/19-open-weight-vs-frontier.html) — The difference is whether the weights are public, not how big the model is.

## Phase 4: Claude Code
The gateway phase. Half the course inherits its terminology from here.

- [What Claude Code Is](phases/04-claude-code/27-what-claude-code-is.html) — Terminal tool, goal-shaped, agent not completion.
- [Install, First Run, Verify](phases/04-claude-code/28-install-first-run-verify.html) — Presence is not correctness.
- [Files and Edits — and When It Refuses](phases/04-claude-code/29-files-and-edits-and-when-it-refuses.html) — A refusal is information, not a wall.
- [Sessions, /clear, /compact](phases/04-claude-code/30-sessions-clear-compact.html) — A session has memory. It fills up.
- [The Agentic Loop](phases/04-claude-code/31-the-agentic-loop.html) — read, decide, act, observe. The reframe.
- [What Loads Into the Window, and What Doesn't](phases/04-claude-code/32-what-loads-into-the-window.html) — The block is a budget.
- [Permissions and Permission Modes](phases/04-claude-code/33-permissions-and-permission-modes.html) — The folder trust prompt is the boundary.
- [Settings: 4 Files, 5 Precedence Levels](phases/04-claude-code/34-settings-and-precedence.html) — Arrays merge, scalars replace.
- [Plan Mode and Checkpoints](phases/04-claude-code/35-plan-mode-and-checkpoints.html) — Plan mode is a permission context, not a different model.
- [Checkpointing, /rewind, Recovery](phases/04-claude-code/36-checkpointing-rewind-recovery.html) — The undo for a multi-step tool session.
- [Troubleshooting: Reading Errors Properly](phases/04-claude-code/37-troubleshooting-reading-errors-properly.html) — Most "the tool is broken" reports are "I did not read the error."

## Phases 5–18

See [catalog.html](catalog.html) for the full phase list. Phases 05–18 cover skills, subagents, MCP, hooks, plugins, memory, parallelism, context engineering, harness engineering, graph engineering, worktrees in practice, scaling, and the capstone.

## Plugin surface (for agents)

- Streamable HTTP MCP at `/mcp` — tools: `search_curriculum`, `read_resource` (read-only)
- REST API: `/api/v1/catalog`, `/api/v1/resource?path=…`, `/api/v1/markdown?path=…`
- OpenAPI: `/openapi.json`
- MCP manifest: `/server.json` (also `/.well-known/mcp.json`)
- Content negotiation: `Accept: text/markdown` on any page returns the markdown twin
- All routes are static; no auth, no accounts, no write endpoints
- Quotas: 120 req/min/IP per function instance, advertised via `RateLimit-Policy` headers
